purpose: Load-independence guardrail: provoke load-induced determinism failures (P0) by running Hermit determinism tests x N concurrently and diffing output hash / verify verdict / schedule fingerprint across identical reps.

host.cgroup: v2, delegated io+memory+pids (NOT cpu); systemd --user scopes available

stack: safe-ci-dag-runner: singleton DAG, outer cgroup MemoryMax cap (systemd --user scope, Delegate=yes, MemorySwapMax=0), verified active before run, per-step + whole-run resource CSVs (profiling), full-descendant reap on exit
harness.py: bounded worker pool (Nprocs..2xNprocs) of parallel `hermit run --strict --verify` reps in reps or timed(fair-hot-loop) mode
cross-rep divergence detection: output-hash / verify-verdict / schedule-fingerprint == P0

excluded.race: examples/race.sh intentionally chaotic; not a determinism oracle

files.run.sh: CLI launcher; profiles smoke|validate|torture; redirects to results/<profile>_<ts>.log
files.guarded_run.py: cgroup-boxed singleton-DAG safety+profiling wrapper (No-Silent-Failure cap gate)
files.harness.py: bounded worker-pool engine; per-rep 2-invocation oracle; _classify severity model
files.test_classify.py: dependency-free self-test: 26 asserts over _classify (all P0 branches + precedence + timeout-tolerance) and _count_fp (order-invariance, move-detection, mismatch-preservation); python3 test_classify.py, exit 0 = OK

severity_model.GREEN: all reps agree (1 output hash, verify passes, 1 count fingerprint)
severity_model.P0_VERIFY_FLIP: verify passes some reps, fails others
severity_model.PREEXISTING_VERIFY_FAIL: verify fails consistently (real bug, not load-induced)
severity_model.INCONCLUSIVE: too few reps scored (e.g. all timed out)
severity_model.timeouts: recorded as perf note, never P0 alone

progressbar.note: both reps hit 120s wall-clock timeout; correctly not a P0

phase2_timed_hotloop_smoke.profile: torture (timed fair hot-loop, minutes=3, pool auto=474, mem_cap 64G, per_run_timeout 120)

findings.load_independence: Held across ambient load 56->1247 (~20x swing): every test with >=2 scored reps produced exactly 1 output hash + 1 schedule fingerprint. No P0 across all three phases.
findings.date_ns_cross_invocation_drift: date.sh virtual epoch nanosecond field is byte-identical within a burst but drifts ~1.3us across separate hermit invocations minutes apart (smoke 142e/validate bd10/timed 48118b); NOT load-induced (stable within each run) so not a guardrail P0; separate owner-gated clock-domain investigation (cf #1095/PMU-skid/GuestClock).
findings.real_torture_tuning: Raise PER_RUN_TIMEOUT to ~600s and/or lower oversubscription factor toward 1.0-1.2 so rand/progressbar also score; fast tests carry the signal regardless. Timed-mode drain tail: deadline bounds STARTING reps; in-flight reps drain, so a 3-min window took 666s wall under extreme oversubscription.
